g.text: Education expenditure per year (Rs, logarithmic scale)
Annual education expenditure among rural Sindh students
Data: PSLM 2019-20, person and household files.
Rural Sindh; 1,440 students with positive education expenditure.
1 observations outside the displayed expenditure range were excluded.
Household-weighted histogram; bin width = 0.1 log10 units.
